description: RecyclerView adapter class for displaying a list of notes in an Android application, including view holder class and list update method.

classes.name: NotesAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for handling and displaying a list of Note objects in the UI. Supports data submission and item click handling.

classes.name: NotesAdapter.NoteViewHolder
classes.description: Inner class serving as the ViewHolder for the adapter, binding note data to the UI components.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data list with a new list of notes and refreshes the UI.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ViewHolder for a note item view.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of note items to display.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a Note object to a ViewHolder at a specific position.

methods.name: NoteViewHolder.bind
methods.description: Binds a Note object's data to the corresponding UI components within the view holder.
